study_identification_part.si_4_title: Heterogeneity of morphometric similarity networks in health and schizophrenia

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Public datasets: Amsterdam Open MRI Collection (aomic id1000, piop1, piop2); Cam-CAN; Dallas Longitudinal Brain Study (dlbs); IXI; Narratives; OASIS3; NKI-Rockland; SALD. Clinical dataset: Utrecht Schizophrenia project and GROUP consortium. AOMIC/DLBS/Narratives/SALD are not in the predefined taxonomy, so marked as Unknown.
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "We included healthy participants from ten publicly available datasets: the Amsterdam Open MRI Collection (aomic) (id1000, piop1 and piop2) datasets..., the Cambridge Centre for Ageing and Neuroscience (camcan) dataset..., the Dallas Longitudinal Brain Study (dlbs) dataset..., the Information eXtraction from Images (ixi) dataset..., the Narratives (narratives) dataset..., the Open Access Series of Imaging Studies (oasis3) dataset..., the NKI-Rockland (rockland) dataset... and the Southwest University adult lifespan (sald) dataset... One dataset is not publicly available and consisted of a large longitudinal sample of individuals with schizophrenia and healthy participants... from the Utrecht Schizophrenia project and the Genetic Risk and Outcome of Psychosis (GROUP) consortium."

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Ten healthy-only datasets were split per dataset into training (≈90%) and test (≈10%) sets for normative modeling. The longitudinal clinical dataset contributed healthy controls to training (20%) and test (80%), while all schizophrenia participants were included in the test set.
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "For normative modeling, each of the ten datasets containing only healthy controls was split into a training set (≈90%) and a test set (≈10%)... For the clinical dataset, all individuals with schizophrenia, as well as 80% of the healthy controls, were included in the test set, while the remaining healthy controls (20%) were included in the training set."
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.location: Janssen2024.pdf.md: Normative modeling of morphometric similarity
